decisions.question: Canonical Android package name (immutable once published on Play). Handoff doc flagged a mismatch: applicationId cz.audory.app vs OAuth redirect scheme com.audory.app://.
rationale: Reverse-DNS of audory.hylmar.eu, a domain the owner controls (info@hylmar.eu / hylmar.eu resolves 81.2.196.19; audory.hylmar.eu resolves same). com.audory.* would reverse-map to audory.com, registered to a third party via GoDaddy since 2014-12-27. cz.audory.* maps to audory.cz which is unregistered (not owned).
AGP 8.4.2 decouples applicationId from namespace, so Play identity can be eu.hylmar.audory.app while Kotlin namespaces stay cz.audory.* unchanged — no source-tree churn.

Custom scheme chosen for now (simplest, unblocks). Can upgrade to verifiable Android App Links https://audory.hylmar.eu/oauth/callback later, once Play App Signing SHA-256 (task 6.5) is available to publish assetlinks.json.

domain_rdap.audory.com: registered 2014-12-27, GoDaddy, parked (DomainControl NS), expires 2026-12-27 — third party

research.part_a_impact: NONE — Google→Cognito federation redirect is the HTTPS .../oauth2/idpresponse URL, not the custom scheme. D1 gates only Play package (6.5) and the native app's own redirect.
